lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: A standalone comedy episode: a car flipper goes on a date with a girl who sells a Camry. Lis is a deadpan ironic narrator. Last line — a confident, warm, clear advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват».

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Line 1: businesslike, suspicious, totally unromantic. Line 2: excited haggling, proud. Line 3: crushed, quiet, defeated.

stas.profile: Stas — an exhausted Russian used-car flipper in his 30s who hasn't slept for three days.
stas.notes: Line 1: on the phone, polite and fast, decisive. Line 2: confident, charming.

vika.profile: Vika — a confident, charming young Russian woman in her 20s on a date; ironic, clear voice.
vika.notes: Line 1: warm, flirty. Line 2: annoyed, ironic. Line 3: apologetic but happy, already leaving.

waiter.profile: A polite, formal Russian restaurant waiter.
waiter.notes: One line: polite, neutral, a bit too cheerful.
